'''''Mechtech Illustrated''''' was a publication focused on [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. Their review of the [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droid]] was extremely favorable, describing it as the one of the most versatile multi-purpose droids available, citing among others its capabilities for starship repair, security access, and navicomputer interface.<ref name="TRG1-112" />

They published an especially harsh review of the [[R5-series astromech droid]] shortly after its release calling it "a meter-tall stack of the worst business decisions you could possibly want".<ref name="Hnn">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|45|business/13228_3.html|IA Pulls R5's Plug}}</ref>
